field.label: Enable
field.help: Enable or disable the stunmesh-go service.

field.label: Configuration source
field.help: "Generate from Interfaces and Peers" builds the configuration from the Storage plugins, Interfaces and Peers tabs below. "Custom YAML" writes the text in the Configuration box below verbatim instead.

field.label: Refresh interval
field.help: How often stunmesh-go refreshes peer endpoints, as a Go duration (e.g. 10m, 30s). Used in generated mode.

field.label: STUN servers
field.help: Comma separated list of host:port STUN servers. Used in generated mode.

field.label: Default ping interval
field.help: Optional global default ping interval, as a Go duration (e.g. 1s). Used in generated mode.

field.label: Default ping timeout
field.help: Optional global default ping timeout, as a Go duration (e.g. 1s). Used in generated mode.

field.label: Default ping fixed retries
field.help: Optional global default number of fixed ping retries. Used in generated mode.

field.label: Configuration
field.help: The full stunmesh-go YAML configuration, written verbatim to /usr/local/etc/stunmesh/config.yaml when the configuration source is "Custom YAML". See https://docs.stunmesh.dev for the configuration reference. The file on disk is regenerated only when Apply is pressed; use "Show current config" below to see what is currently deployed. In "Generate from Interfaces and Peers" mode, the shown file is what the Interfaces and Peers tabs produce, and this box is ignored.
